title: Harbourlight Symphony: Tides
description: A full orchestra plays a new suite written for the harbour, from slack water to king tide. Big brass, bigger windows.

title: Sandstone Sunset Strings
description: A string quartet plays on the sandstone terraces as the sun drops behind the western suburbs. Bring a blanket.

title: Low Tide Jazz on the Lawn
description: A brassy jazz band on the harbourside lawn, with the city skyline turning gold behind the moored boats.

title: Lumen: Late at the Gallery
venue: Art Gallery of New South Wales
description: The galleries stay open after dark with live drawing, ten-minute talks and a DJ in the entrance court.

title: Signal & Steam
description: Room-sized light and sound installations fill the old rail workshops. Walk through a cloud of humming colour.

title: Paper Tides: New Printmakers
description: Fifty young printmakers, one very long wall, and a working press where you can pull a print of your own.

title: Dumpling Lane Night
description: Forty stalls folding, steaming and frying dumplings under paper lanterns. Follow the longest queues.

title: Salt & Smoke Seafood Feast
description: Grilled prawns, oysters and charred corn all along the Corso, a short walk from the surf.

title: Harbour Pantry Tasting Halls
description: Chefs' demonstrations, three tasting halls and a cheese room the size of a tennis court.

title: Glebe Vinyl & Vintage Fair
description: Crates of records, racks of old denim and a busker on every corner of the schoolyard.

title: Lantern Night Market
description: Makers, street food and paper lanterns strung over the cobbled lanes in the shadow of the Bridge.

title: Oxford Street Makers Market
description: Handmade jewellery, ceramics and clothes from local designers, in the church grounds on Oxford Street.

title: Grade Cricket Finals Day
description: The club season's last day: two finals back to back, and picnic rugs on the grass hill.

title: Harbour City v Coastline FC
description: The big local derby under lights. Expect drums, a sea of scarves and forty thousand voices.

title: Centennial Dawn 10K
description: A flat, fast loop of the park's Grand Drive, with a coffee cart waiting at the finish line.

title: King Street Laneway Lates
description: Small bars along King Street open up their back lanes for DJs, neon and late-night snacks.

title: Luna After Dark
description: The rides keep spinning for grown-ups only, with DJs on the boardwalk and the city lights across the water.

title: Neon Tropics Dance Party
description: Six hours of dancing under a ceiling of lasers, with a slow tropical house set to close.

title: Open Mic Mayhem
description: Ten new comics, five minutes each, and a headliner who swears she will keep it short.

title: The Late Late Laugh Lounge
description: Four touring stand-ups in one big old room. Sit near the front at your own risk.

title: Keeper Talks Day
description: Meet the keepers at feeding time, from the seals to the platypus house. Kids collect stamps in a passport.

title: Coogee Kite Day
description: Giant show kites over the sand, a kite-making tent for kids and a sandcastle contest at low tide.

title: Morning Birdsong Walk
description: A guided early-morning walk through the gardens, listening for fifty kinds of bird before the city wakes.

title: Sunrise Ocean Swim
description: A social swim across the bay at sunrise, with lifeguards out the back and warm pastries on the sand.

title: Harbourside Lantern Parade
description: Hundreds of glowing lanterns wind around the promenade, led by drummers, with fireworks to finish.

title: Island Echoes Festival
description: Three stages in the old shipyards, ferries every twenty minutes, and a sunset set over the water.
